card.name: Slashes inside web addresses
card.fires_on: Slash marks and path pieces inside long URLs, mostly after a year/month date segment like 2012/12 in news or blog links in citations.

modes.label: Slash after date in URL
modes.description: The slash following a year/month part of a news or blog link, before the day or article slug.

modes.label: Other URL path pieces
modes.description: A path word or word piece in the middle of a link.

card.plain: It marks the spot inside a web link, usually the slash after the year and month, where the rest of the address follows.
